caption_L1: Here a line plot is titled Consumer price index (CPI) of insurance annually in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2008 to 2019. There is a linear scale from 0 to 120 along the y-axis, marked Consumer price index*. A linear scale with a minimum of 2008 and a maximum of 2018 can be seen on the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: The general trend for the consumer price index is an upward one. Between 2008 and 2018 the consumer price index has almost doubled. The general trend rose only slightly btween 2011 and 2015.
